142.news_title: Arcooda Checkmate Retro Monitor Coming Soon
142.long_description:
We've been working with the Checkmate team to develop an Arcooda Checkmate Retro Monitor that will be using a new Slot 0 board and our 5:4 19inch monitor. New firmware and functions are being updated, and we plan to release both the Arcooda Checkmate monitor as well as an upgrade kit (Slot 0 board with 19inch panel). 

Our monitor will offer 15khz, 25khz, 31khz and 1280x1024 all native input.

Pre-order and final specifications will be available in February.
